'''Chemplast Sanmar Limited''' is an Indian chemical company.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://matrixmetalsglobal.com/about-us/|title=Stainless Steel Foundry | Steel Casting Foundry | Matrix Metals Foundry India USA Mexico ||date=12 October 2018}}</ref> It is a major manufacturer of PVC resins, chlorochemicals and piping systems.

==History==
The company was formed in 1962 to manufacture [[PVC]] resins/compounds and fabricate PVC products. In 1967 a PVC Plant at Mettur was commissioned with a capacity of 6,000 TPA, in collaboration with [[BF Goodrich]]. PVC pipes production commenced.  It was among the pioneers to bring PVC pipes to India.{{citation needed|date=June 2021}}

In 1985 the company acquired a controlling stake of Mettur Chemical & Industrial Corporation (MCIC) Ltd.{{citation needed|date=June 2021}}

The Cuddalore PVC project was commissioned in September 2009.

In August 2021, Chemplast Sanmar opened its [[initial public offering]] at a price band of {{INR}} 530-541 per share.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Chemplast Sanmar IPO To Open Tomorrow. Here Is All You Need To Know|url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/chemplast-sanmar-ipo-news-chemplast-sanmar-ipo-to-open-tomorrow-price-band-ipo-dates-lot-size-other-details-here-2506152|access-date=2021-08-09|website=NDTV.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|last=Nahar|first=Pawan|title=Chemplast Sanmar IPO opens on Tuesday: Key things to know before applying|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/chemplast-sanmar-ipo-opens-on-tuesday-key-things-to-know-before-applying/articleshow/85175025.cms|access-date=2021-08-09}}</ref>

== Organization ==
Chemplast Sanmar Limited is part of Sanmar Group which has businesses in Chemicals, Shipping, Engineering and Metals. It has a turnover of over {{INR}} 65 billion and a presence in some 25 businesses, with manufacturing units spread over numerous locations in India.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.sanmargroup.com/Misc-files/grouprof.htm |title=The Sanmar Group |accessdate=2008-08-04 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080807021319/http://www.sanmargroup.com/Misc-files/grouprof.htm |archivedate=7 August 2008 }}</ref><ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://www.rediff.com/business/slide-show/slide-show-1-interview-meet-the-man-behind-a-rs-4500-crore-empire/20101216.htm|title=Meet the man behind a Rs 4,500-crore empire|website=Rediff}}</ref>

Chemplast Sanmar's manufacturing facilities are located at [[Mettur]], [[Panruti]], [[Cuddalore]] and [[Ponneri]] in Tamil Nadu, Shinoli in Maharashtra, and [[Karaikal]] in the Union Territory of [[Puducherry (union territory)|Puducherry]].

Cuddalore PCV is the largest such project in Tamil Nadu. Its aggregate capacity of 235,000 tons makes it one of India's largest PVC players.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/chemplast-sets-up-pvc-plant-at-cuddalore-109092100084_1.html|title=Chemplast sets up PVC plant at Cuddalore|first=T. E.|last=Narasimhan|newspaper=Business Standard India |date=21 September 2009|via=Business Standard}}</ref>

Mettur Chemical & Industrial Corporation (MCIC) Ltd makes [[caustic soda]] 48000 TPA and [[chloromethane]] 11000 TPA.

===Zero liquid discharge===
Chemplast Sanmar implemented [[zero liquid discharge]] in all its manufacturing plants. Chemplast has not discharged treated effluent since September 2009 in Mettur while Cuddalore and Karaikkal have never discharged treated effluent.<ref name="auto1">{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Chemplast-wins-two-awards/article15591891.ece|title=Chemplast wins two awards|newspaper=The Hindu |date=13 December 2010}}</ref>

== Recognition ==

* "Innovative Case Study" at the 7th National Award for Excellence in Water Management (2010)<ref name=":0" />
* "Excellent Water Efficient Unit" 7th National Award for Excellence in Water Management (2010) for the successful case study of zero liquid discharge at Mettur.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |date=2010-12-13 |title=Chemplast wins two awards |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Chemplast-wins-two-awards/article15591891.ece |access-date=2025-07-02 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}}</ref>

==Sports==
The Sanmar Group has supported [[cricket]] for over 50 years. Chemplast Sanmar supports Jolly Rovers and the Alwarpet Cricket Club in the Tamil Nadu Cricket Academy (TNCA) 1st Division.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/features/metroplus/society/Pitching-for-cricket/article12077965.ece|title=Pitching for cricket|first=Prince|last=Frederick|newspaper=The Hindu |date=6 October 2009}}</ref>
